text:
DJIA Market Happenings For Monday, December 17, 2018 Posted by admin on December 17th, 2018
Dow stocks at 52 week highs include Procter & Gamble (PG). Dow stock 52 week lows include Goldman Sachs (GS).
The Market
Premarket today, the Dow was indicated to open down -133 points.
Friday the Dow was down -496.67 (-2.02%) at 24,100.51.
Year-to-date the Dow is down -2.50%.
There were 2 Dow stocks up Friday.
The Dow stock winners Friday were Caterpillar (CAT) +0.69% and Procter & Gamble (PG) +0.16%.
The Dow stock losers Friday were led by Johnson & Johsnon (JNJ) -10.04%, Walgreens (WBA) -4.35%, Cisco (CSCO) -3.48%, APple (AAPL) -3.20% and Microsoft (MSFT) -3.12%.
European stocks are lower and Asian markets ended mostly higher.
The national average price of gasoline is down five-tenths of a cent at $2.373 per gallon.
Earnings Reports .
Walgreens (WBA) reports earnings on 12/20/2018 before the market open.
Nike (NKE) reports earnings on 12/20/2018 after the market close.
